description: Shared helper: the weight of a cart line ignores the quantity. The wrong value flows through Cart.total_weight_g into shipping in checkout.
report_specific: Cart.total_weight_g() returns 420 for a cart with 2 x PEN-001 (20 g each) and 1 x MUG-003 (400 g). It should be 440. Orders with several units of the same item are charged shipping for too little weight.
report_vague: Customers who order many copies of the same heavy item pay the same shipping as if they had ordered just one.

decoys.why: computes shipping from the weight, but is correct
sums the line weights, but is correct
